recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28132; future changes to the extension definitions should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or under a new tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-28132 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire request to correct the quantity item-type guidance so quantity points to questionnaire-unitOption and questionnaire-unitValueSet, while integer and decimal point to questionnaire-unit for computable extraction units.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in e096aeb964, which updated source/questionnaire/codesystem-item-type.xml by adding questionnaire-unit text to decimal and integer and changing quantity to reference questionnaire-unitOption and questionnaire-unitValueSet for Quantity.code and Quantity.system.
additional_context: Questionnaire and the item-type value set are active in source/fhir.ini, and source/questionnaire/valueset-item-type.xml composes http://hl7.org/fhir/item-type from the neighboring code system. Current Extension Pack definitions confirm questionnaire-unit is constrained to integer/decimal and unitOption/unitValueSet to quantity; later FHIR-37363 placed the detailed allowed-unit matching rules in those extension definitions. Related FHIR-34391 and FHIR-37363 already have combined-branch audit commits, so they were not republished.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current code system already has questionnaire-unit only for decimal/integer and questionnaire-unitOption/questionnaire-unitValueSet for quantity, and no obsolete quantity wording pointing to questionnaire-unit remains in current core source.
